summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K disclosing a November 4, 2026 Purchase Agreement under which Executive Chairman Jiawei Wang bought one share of newly designated Series A Preferred Stock for $100, closing same day. The share carries super-voting rights contractually bound to mirror common and Series B/Series C votes on the Reverse Stock Split Proposal, but only once a one-third quorum of those classes is present; absent quorum the share stays unvoted. Mechanics create a quorum/pass gate for the reverse split rather than a conventional special situation; watch meeting turnout and whether the arrangement is challenged as entrenchment.
